note: Signed, fail-closed runtime kill-switch control plane. Each entry SUSPENDS a capability at a scope so the runtime REFUSES it without a code change: global scopes (research | publication | printing | decoding) or a specific election | chamber | electorate | ballot | mapping | proposition | map. Edit the `suspensions` list, then run `pnpm control-plane:generate` to re-sign — the `integrity` digest is checked at build (scripts/check-control-plane.mjs, blocking) and re-verified synchronously at runtime (apps/web/src/lib/governance), which refuses EVERYTHING if it does not match. Each entry carries who/when/why (by, flaggedAt, reason) for the audit trail; a lifted suspension keeps an audited RESTORE record (liftedAt/liftedBy) rather than being deleted. This subsumes data/corrections/suspensions.json (the `mapping` scope). Empty (or fully-lifted) `suspensions` means nothing is currently withdrawn. The `printing` and `research` global suspensions below were the constrained product boundary from the 2026-07-19 deep legal review; both were LIFTED on 2026-07-19 (RESTORE records) once the two-person compliance review signed off the print-authoriser and Privacy-Act determinations (data/legal/product-boundary.json, EV-LEGAL-DEEP-2026-07). They are kept as audited RESTORE records rather than deleted.
